newsitem.title: USA: First Commercial to buy First Central.
newsitem.headline: First Commercial to buy First Central.

text.p: First Commercial Corp said on Thursday it executed a definitive agreement to acquire First Central Corp of Searcy, Ark., in an exchange of stock valued at $62 million.

First Commercial will exchange 1.65 million of its common shares for all outstanding First Central shares. The transaction is expected to close in the second quarter of 1997, subject to regulatory approval.

First Central is the parent of First National Bank of Searcy, with assets of about $260 million. First Commercial is a $5.4 billion holding company with 24 affiliate banks in Arkansas, Texas, Tennessee and Louisiana.
